Well, you see, I ignored warnings from the locals that the mistress of the tower doesn't take kindly to men. I thought it was an exaggeration. But I learned the hard way that it was not and Mistress Dratha threw me out here and laid a hefty curse on me for attempting to peddle pillows in her pod. I need help removing this curse of paralysis.
I've been cursed with paralysis. I've passed out five times after I couldn't scratch an itch. You have no idea what it's like!
It's because I liked the view before; but now you've gone and ruined it.
Never mind me then. I'm just dying of the chills on account of standing out in the rain for days. A merry journey to you, orc-shit.
You rude %PCRace! Fine, then! Just leave me here to die of the chills.
Please, can you help me?
Come to gawk, %PCRace?

Well, well. Aryon's pet back to snoop around. Find what you were looking for then, %PCName? Perhaps instead of killing each other, we can strike a bargain. Aryon can have the dwemer ideographer -- for a price. I have figured out a way to replicate the process on a smaller scale which suits my needs. And I could use some of Aryon's gold to invest in my tower and attract my own retainers.

Thanks for talking me out of making a big mistake, %PCName. I never would have been able to deal with the stigma from leaving House Telvanni. Ulyno tried to tell me, but I wouldn't listen. Come see me in Sadrith Mora sometime.
You speak the truth, %PCName. Very well. Please tell Master Aryon that I accept his offer to be his Mouth.
Ulyno is sure that she can curry favor with one of the councilors to be my advocate. But I admit that I have doubts.
Even so, why should I stay in House Telvanni? I haven't gotten an advancement in years despite all my efforts.
Whatever.
It's too late, I've already set things in motion to leave House Telvanni. I have aspirations and I believe that I can go far in House Redoran.
I wasn't planning to. Get out.
So I get your leavings now that you're done with the position?
You know mine.
Excuse me, but I have no business with you, %PCName.
%PCName, a courier from Tel Vos stopped by while you were away. She left this letter.
Ho, friend. Are you here in Vos to do business?
House business waits for no man, %PCRace.
Stay out of the way.
You don't need to be down here, %PCRace. Shove off.
I can't prove that you magicked yourself out of the cell, but you know what you did... I'm watching you.
I understand, %PCName. Master Aryon can be overzealous with his security precautions. Watch where you're going from now on.
You expect me to believe that!? Hah! Maybe you can think up a better excuse while you sit in that cell.
That should cover your fine, %PCName. Stay out of trouble.
You don't have enough gold to cover the fine, %PCName. And I think you'll have a hard time finding more in there. Haha!
My mistake, %PCName. Please accept my apology.
Master Aryon didn't tell me anything about auditing his security. You can rot in your cell, trickster.
Why should I? I'm sure Master Aryon had a good reason for dropping you in my cell.
You'll kill me? I doubt it, fetcher. Only a fool lashes out in anger after humiliating themselves.
You'll kill me? Maybe so, but I'll die with a smile on my face. Only a fool lashes out in anger after humiliating themselves.
You're in the Tel Vos Jail. You were probably snooping around somewhere you didn't belong.
Sit there and sulk then.
Took a wrong turn, %PCRace? Hahaha!
Getting bored, %PCRace? Ha!
What do you want now, prisoner?
Stay out of trouble, %PCName.
Keep your nose out of places it doesn't belong from now on.
I'm still writing my report. Don't make me do anymore paperwork...
I've got my eyes on you.
Last time in my cell wasn't enough for you, eh, %PCName? Well, I hope you're ready to spend a very long time in that cell.
I have nothing to say to you.
I'd appreciate it if you'd leave my fields, outlander. I've nothing more to speak with you about.

Welcome back to Tel Vos, %PCName. I trust that you received my message then? Couriers are expensive -- particularly those willing to trek into the wastes of Molag Amur -- but I considered the matter of enough importance to warrant it. Since you are here, I assume you are willing to help me select a new mouth for Aryon?
I have nothing more to say to you, %PCRank.
[Galos Mathendis looks at you with disgust.]
Oh, %PCName. How fortuitous that you stopped by. I dispatched a courier to your Stronghold, but you were away at the time. I wonder if you would be willing to help me select a new mouth for Aryon.

Oh, hello, %PCName. You'll have to excuse the clutter from my projects. But at least I don't have kwama eggs decorating the walls, eh? Ha ha! Speaking of Therana, I do believe that serving as the Mouth for a clearly and hopelessly mad mistress was starting to affect Felisa Ulessen by the time I retired. You know I caught her keeping a pet spider in her robe? She ate it when I pointed it out...

It's so refreshing living here in Tel Vos. Away from the pompous politics of Council work. Mallam Ryon was always the worst. Just because he was the Archmagister's Mouth, he thought his voice carried more weight than anyone else in matters of debate. Not much longer and I think he'll find himself in need of a new job.

Hello again, %PCName. Come to ask questons about my research? At least you don't have to worry about mine involving unholy powers at every turn. Unlike with Raven Omayn and Dratha. I used to hear Raven muttering things to herself, dark, brooding things. I don't miss her company.

When I was in a sunny mood, I used to imagine clandestine trysts with Arara Uvulas -- such a fiery personality. But then a gloomy day would come around and I'd remember she was just as ruthless as Neloth. Too much time standing around with the same people really weakens one's inhibitions... Oh, you'll have to excuse me %PCName, spending time by myself makes me reflective.
You found me.
Watch your step around the wickwheat, outlander. These plants are my livelihood, thank you. If only those mushroom roots from Tel Vos would be as considerate.
%PCName. Thank you again for your help. Now that you're a %PCRank, maybe you'd be willing to help me with slightly more sensitive work.
I serve Master Aryon as a guard here in Tel Vos. I'm trained in lethal spellcasting and armored combat. Follow the laws of House Telvanni here, %PCClass, or face the consequences.
Name's %name. I'm a sailor on Falvilo's Endeavor. I work for Sedyni Veran; she's the captain.

All miners here are Ashlanders. Master Aryon hires us. The land no longer provides enough for all to live. We must seek the help of the settled people to survive. Master Aryon has potions to protect us from the red dust.
You mean how did an Ashlander learn to work with metal? I studied and I practiced. How does anyone?
You mean how did an Ashlander learn to work with metal? I'm afraid I'm too busy to discuss my history with and outlander.
I don't know.
There weren't any candles in the propylon chamber.
I knew you must have found my note to Telvon. I have no idea where he is. He was a bull-headed man and I fear that he may have entered the ruins of Indoranyon despite my warning.
When I appeared inside the ruins, I was surrounded by blue candles. The same candles surrounded the door I left through.
I... uh. Yes, but I picked the lock to the ruins.
It's a Dunmer stronghold here in the Grazelands. What about it?
Please don't use the scroll until you're on top of the ruins of Indoranyon, %PCName. You'll just complicate things if you mess this up.

No key, yes that makes sense. Blue candles, of course. And her accomplice. Gone! %PCName, I must go to Indoranyon. But I'm past the days where I am interested in making the journey myself. Go to Indoranyon and cast this scroll on top of the ruins near the door to the deeper ruins. I'll meet you there.
Please find the ashlander scout in Varo Tradehouse and ask her the questions I gave you. In order, %PCName. In order!

Yes, I have reason to believe that this scout has recently been to the dunmer stronghold of Indoranyon which is located here in the Grazelands. I've prepared a list of questions for you. It's important that you ask them in order or else you may not learn what I need you to.
What brings you to Odirniran, %PCRank? Mind the guardians.
We don't have every amenity here. But Master Faram has big plans for this place. Just you wait.
House Hlaalu won't try to assault this tower again. But if they do, we'll be ready.
Master Faram is establishing a strong presence in this area now that House Hlaalu has been kicked out.

Excellent. Go get those bastard Ashlanders. I promise, when you get those hides back to me, Berwen will be very generous. She has a stake in this trade, after all, and we can't let an unwarranted attack on a guar hide trader ruin business. By the way, I would also appreciate it if you could lead my pack guar back here. That is if those savages haven't eaten it already.
I am a smith. I repair and make all manner of metal goods for the village. Cart wheels, nails, utensils, tools... I could go on but I'm busy filling orders. Do you need something repaired?
